meta.title: حلقة واحدة بس قبل النوم
meta.topic:
Create a high-impact, editorial 9:16 vertical motion graphics reel (45–50 seconds, 60fps) warning about how anime like Naruto introduces hidden polytheistic beliefs (Shinto/Buddhist concepts) and consumes a Muslim's time and prayers.

Visual Rules & Palette:
- Deep charcoal-obsidian background (#0B0F14), crimson warning accents (#EF4444), clean emerald resolution accents (#10B981), and crisp off-white typography (#F8FAFC) with strict WCAG contrast.
- Depict any human figure strictly as a smooth, completely featureless silhouette.
- Use abstract geometric symbols, seals, clocks, and minimalist iconography instead of copyrighted anime characters.
- Audio: Realistic tactile Foley sound effects only (rapid clock ticking, screen clicks, low rumble, deep breath) — strictly ZERO background music.
- Respect 9:16 safe zones and synchronize Arabic word-by-word captions with key emphasis highlights.

Scene Breakdown:
1. Hook (0–6s): Giant digital clock rapidly flipping from "11:30 PM" to "04:45 AM" in crimson as a subtle crescent/Fajr prayer indicator fades out in the background.
2. Hidden Beliefs (6–22s): Rotating abstract geometric seals and dual-circle balance symbols fracture apart to reveal bold Arabic warning callouts: "تناسخ الأرواح" (Reincarnation), "آلهة الموت" (Gods of Death), and "التعاويذ" (Incantations).
3. Time & Prayer Drain (22–38s): A fast-filling episode progress bar ("720 حلقة") compresses 5 vertical pillars representing the 5 daily prayers down to near zero, beside a featureless silhouette hunched in front of a glowing screen.
4. Awakening & Resolution (38–50s): Crimson alerts power down into a calm emerald-lit frame; the clock stops completely, displaying the final Arabic reminder cleanly inside the safe zone: "صلاتك خط أحمر".
